title: validate-json-schema: support propertyNames for typed extension namespaces
description: Root/fleet sync-context capture attempted to validate the enacted RoleSurfaceManifestModel v0.0.8 and received a loud unsupported-keyword refusal at /extensions because the schema uses propertyNames with pattern ^x-. The refusal correctly avoids silent partial validation, but it leaves role records on the manual fallback even though property-name validation is bounded and required by the live schema contract.
acceptanceCriteria: propertyNames evaluates every object property name against its subschema under JSON Schema draft 2020-12 semantics.
A role extension object containing only x-prefixed keys passes the v0.0.8 role-surface-manifest schema.
A counterexample containing a non-x-prefixed extension key fails at the exact property-name instance path.
The canonical Root/fleet sync-context steward role validates through vaporize validate-json-schema without manual fallback.
Unsupported assertion-keyword refusal remains loud for genuinely unsupported features.

relatedTypedRecords.t: Root and fleet sync-context capture instance
